title: 3C Carrot or Stick? — Идиомы: убеждение и мотивация

items.example: The essay compares the carrot and the stick in motivating people.
They twisted his arm to join the gym with them.
She talked me into revising with her every evening.
It took weeks to bring the manager round to the four-day week.
Free gifts sweeten the deal for hesitant buyers.
She drove a hard bargain and got a good discount.
Negotiation needs give and take from both sides.
Parents and teens should meet halfway on screen time.
He pulled strings to get his son an interview.
The company played hardball and threatened big fines.
A small bonus softened the blow of the pay freeze.
They sugared the pill of extra homework with a class trip.
Bosses dangle a carrot of promotion to boost effort.
She sold the team on going green with clear numbers.
